impact: Users following the README (npm install -g + zug setup) never get hooks registered. Context is not persisted at compaction and not injected on resume. The README promises this as a first-class Claude Code feature but setup.ts never calls the hook-writing code from install.sh.
resolution: Added mergeClaudeHooks() to runSetup() in setup.ts. Now registers PreCompact (zug compact) and SessionStart (zug resume) hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json whenever claude target is configured. Also added resolveZugBin() to find the installed binary path.
title: zug setup skips hook registration — PreCompact and SessionStart hooks never written
